name: Oborotsukiyo no Kimi
source:
One of the five moonbeam wisemen, despite his frivolous personality.
The son of the Minister of the Right.
He's used to dealing with women and is famous around the imperial court for being a womanizer.
He's courting many other noble women, than the Hikaru no Miya.
